response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.entrystat, e.ambictemp, e.imgcount FROM scanenvironment AS e JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref WHERE s.entrystat IS NOT NULL) SELECT entrystat, AVG(ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(imgcount) AS avg_imgcount, AVG(imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(imgcount) FROM matched) AS imgcount_vs_overall FROM matched GROUP BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: Overall means all environment records matched to a site with a known access status. AVG independently ignores missing temperatures and image counts.
